<infobox theme="Lightsaber">
	<image source="imagefallback">
		<default>{{InfoboxGallery|image={{{image|}}}|caption1={{{option1|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{option2|}}}|image3={{{image3|}}}|caption3={{{option3|}}}}}</default>
	</image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="model"><label>Model</label></data>	
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="culture"><label>Culture</label></data>
        <data source="creator"><label>Creators</label></data>			
        <data source="created"><label>Date created</label></data>	
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Date destroyed</label></data>	
        <data source="discovered"><label>Date discovered</label></data>	
        <data source="owners"><label>Owners</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical and technical specifications</header>
        <data source="hilt model"><label>Hilt model</label></data>
        <data source="hilt shape"><label>Hilt shape</label></data>			
        <data source="hilt length"><label>Hilt length</label></data>	
        <data source="hilt material"><label>Hilt material</label></data>
        <data source="crystal"><label>Crystal</label></data>	
        <data source="blade type"><label>Blade type</label></data>
        <data source="color"><label>Blade color</label></data>	
        <data source="blade length"><label>Blade length</label></data>	
        <data source="mods"><label>Modification(s)</label></data>
        <data source="weight"><label>Weight</label></data>	
        <data source="protection"><label>Protection type</label></data>	        
        <data source="capacity"><label>Capacity</label></data>	
        <data source="range"><label>Range</label></data>	
        <data source="design"><label>Design</label></data>	
        <data source="markings"><label>Other markings</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Usage and history</header>
        <data source="precede"><label>Preceding lightsaber(s)</label></data>
        <data source="succeed"><label>Succeeding lightsaber(s)</label></data>
        <data source="purpose"><label>Purpose</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Lightsaber|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
